1-2 rhythm jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Do one small pogo hop, then one big jump
3. Keep the rhythm going
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Land on the balls of your feet.
2 up 1 down straight leg calf raise elev:
Steps
1. Stand with the balls of both feet on the edge of a step, heels hanging off and knees straight
2. Rise up onto your toes using both legs
3. Shift your weight onto one leg at the top
4. Slowly lower that heel below the step over 3 to 5 seconds
5. Put the other foot back down and repeat

Tip
Hold a rail or wall for balance so the calf does the work, not your balance.
3 point sprint start:
Steps
1. Get into a staggered stance with one hand on the ground
2. Lean your weight forward over the front foot
3. Drive hard off both feet and sprint
4. Accelerate over the set distance

Tip
Push, don't step.
a march - dowel overhead:
Steps
1. Hold a dowel overhead with straight arms
2. March forward, driving one knee up into the A position
3. Land on the ball of the foot
4. Alternate legs

Tip
Stay tall.
a run drill:
Steps
1. Run forward with quick, short steps
2. Drive each knee up to hip height
3. Land on the ball of the foot under your hips
4. Keep going

Tip
Fast turnover and a cyclical leg action.
a skip - dowel overhead:
Steps
1. Hold a dowel overhead with straight arms
2. Skip forward, driving one knee up into the A position
3. Land on the ball of the foot under your hips
4. Alternate legs

Tip
Stay tall with the dowel overhead.
a skip switch - double:
Steps
1. Stand in the A position
2. Switch legs twice quickly
3. Hold the A position
4. Repeat

Tip
Land on the ball of the foot.
a skip switch - single:
Steps
1. Stand in the A position
2. Switch legs once quickly
3. Hold the A position
4. Repeat

Tip
Land on the ball of the foot.
a skip switch - triple:
Steps
1. Stand in the A position
2. Switch legs three times quickly
3. Hold the A position
4. Repeat

Tip
Land on the ball of the foot.
a-skip:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Skip forward, driving one knee up to hip height with your toes pulled up
3. Land on the ball of the foot under your hips
4. Alternate legs with opposite arm drive

Tip
Stay tall.
a-triple switch:
Steps
1. Stand tall in the A position: one knee driven up to hip height, toes pulled up, standing on the ball of the other foot
2. Rapidly switch legs three times, driving the down leg into the ground each time
3. Finish on the third switch and hold the A position for a moment
4. Reset and repeat, starting on the other leg

Tip
Stay tall with your hips high. The ground contacts should be quick and quiet.
acceleration to deceleration back step:
Steps
1. Accelerate forward a few steps
2. Stop sharply with a low, wide stance
3. Step back
4. Reset

Tip
Control the stop. Stay low and use your legs.
accentuated eccentric - dumbbell box jum:
Steps
1. Stand holding light dumbbells in front of a box
2. Swing your arms down and drop the dumbbells at the bottom
3. Jump onto the box
4. Step down

Tip
Watch your feet as you drop the dumbbells.
accentuated eccentric - dumbbell jump:
Steps
1. Stand holding light dumbbells
2. Drop into a quarter squat and release the dumbbells at the bottom
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly

Tip
Release cleanly and keep your feet clear.
active recovery:
Steps
1. Choose a light activity such as walking, cycling or easy mobility
2. Keep the effort easy, about 3 to 4 out of 10
3. Keep it going for the set time
4. You should finish feeling better than you started

Tip
A light version of what's prescribed.
alternating box blast:
Steps
1. Stand with one foot on a box
2. Push hard off the box foot and jump up
3. Switch feet in the air
4. Land with the other foot on the box

Tip
A bench or stacked plates works if you don't have a box.
assault bike:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom
2. Start pedalling and pushing and pulling the handles
3. Work at the pace or intensity prescribed
4. Ease off to cool down

Tip
Use your arms and legs together.
back pedal:
Steps
1. Stand in an athletic stance
2. Run backward with short, quick steps
3. Stay low with your chest over your toes
4. Keep going for the set distance

Tip
Push off the front of your feet.
backward figure 8 shuffle:
Steps
1. Set up two cones
2. Shuffle and back pedal around them in a figure 8
3. Stay low
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay facing forward.
backward pogo:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Bounce backwards off the balls of your feet
3. Keep your legs stiff
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Fast contacts off the floor.
backwards pogo jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Bounce backwards off the balls of your feet
3. Keep your legs stiff
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Fast contacts off the floor.
backwards roll into hurdler stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with one leg straight and one bent
2. Roll back onto your shoulders
3. Roll forward into the hurdler stretch, reaching for your straight leg
4. Hold briefly and repeat

Tip
Roll with control.
backwards roll into pancake stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs wide
2. Roll back onto your shoulders
3. Roll forward into a wide-leg pancake stretch, reaching forward
4. Hold briefly and repeat

Tip
Roll with control.
backwards roll to hamstring stretch/reac:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs straight
2. Roll back onto your shoulders
3. Roll forward and reach for your toes
4. Hold briefly and repeat

Tip
Roll with control.
backwards squat walk:
Steps
1. Sit into a semi-squat
2. Walk backward staying in the squat
3. Take small steps
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay as low as is comfortable.
band anchored single arm chest press:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at chest height behind you and hold the handle in one hand
2. Take a split stance with the opposite foot forward and brace your trunk
3. Press the band straight forward until your arm is long
4. Control the band back until your hand is beside your chest

Tip
Don't let the band twist your torso. Keep your hips and shoulders square.
band anchored single arm tricep pushdown:
Steps
1. Anchor a band high and hold it in one hand with your elbow bent and tucked at your side
2. Keep your upper arm still and push your hand down until your elbow is straight
3. Squeeze the back of the arm at the bottom
4. Let your hand come back up slowly to about chest height

Tip
Only your forearm should move.
band assisted alternating split squat ju:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead and hold it or wear it under your arms
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Jump up and switch legs in the air
4. Land and repeat

Tip
The band helps you move faster.
band assisted alternating split stance p:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet, switching legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted alternating staggered plyo:
Steps
1. Loop a band overhead and around your chest
2. Start in a push-up position with your hands staggered
3. Push explosively and switch hands in the air
4. Land and repeat

Tip
The band helps you move faster.
band assisted counter movement jump (cmj:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Drop into a quarter squat and jump
3. Land and jump again straight away
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Thick band for speed, thin band for less help.

Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Drop into a quarter squat and jump
3. Land softly
4. Reset and repeat

Tip
Thick band for speed, thin band for less help.
band assisted pancake stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs wide and a band anchored in front of you
2. Hold the band
3. Let the band pull you forward from your hips
4. Hold the stretch

Tip
Keep your back flat.
band assisted plyo push up:
Steps
1. Loop a band overhead and around your chest
2. Start in a push-up position
3. Push explosively so your hands leave the floor
4. Land and repeat

Tip
The band helps you move faster.
band assisted pogo jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet with stiff legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted reverse nordic:
Steps
1. Kneel tall with a band anchored behind you, looped around your chest
2. Lean back slowly, keeping a straight line from knees to head
3. Go as far as you can control
4. Return to tall kneeling

Tip
The band helps you on the way back up.
band assisted side to side pogo hop:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand on one leg
3. Hop side to side off the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast, then switch

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted side to side pogo jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce side to side off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted single leg jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand on one leg
3. Drop slightly and jump
4. Land softly, then switch

Tip
Thicker bands give more speed.
band assisted single leg pogo hop:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand on one leg
3. Bounce off the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast, then switch

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted split stance counter movem:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Drop and jump, landing in the same stance
4. Jump again straight away

Tip
Thicker bands give more speed.

Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Drop and jump
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Thicker bands give more speed.
band assisted split stance pogo jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted staggered plyo push up:
Steps
1. Loop a band overhead and around your chest
2. Start in a push-up position with your hands staggered
3. Push explosively so your hands leave the floor
4. Land and repeat

Tip
Thick band to move faster, thin band to move a bit slower.
band crossover stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a band around one foot
2. Keep the leg straight and pull it across your body
3. Hold the stretch
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
band external shoulder rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees, forearm across your stomach
3. Rotate your forearm out away from your body, keeping the elbow pinned
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
A rolled towel between your elbow and ribs helps keep the elbow in place.
band internal shoulder rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand closest to the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees, forearm pointing out
3. Rotate your forearm in across your stomach, keeping the elbow pinned
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
Move from the shoulder joint. Your wrist stays straight.
band lateral neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Loop a band around the side of your head just above the ear, anchored to one side
2. Step away from the anchor until you feel tension
3. Keep your head level and upright, resisting the band pulling it sideways
4. Hold for the set time, then turn around and do the other side

Tip
Breathe normally throughout. Stop if you get any pins and needles.
band neck nod:
Steps
1. Loop a light band around the back of your head and anchor it in front of you
2. Sit or stand tall with your chin level
3. Slowly nod your chin down towards your chest against the band
4. Return to level with control

Tip
Small range, slow tempo. This is about control, not load.
band neck protraction + lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your head, anchored behind you
2. Glide your chin forward (protraction) against the band
3. Then tilt your ear towards your shoulder
4. Return to centre and pull your chin back to neutral

Tip
Move slowly and keep your shoulders still.
band neck retraction + lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your forehead, anchored in front of you
2. Draw your chin straight back (a double chin) against the band
3. Then tilt your ear towards your shoulder
4. Return to centre and let your chin glide forward to neutral

Tip
Keep your eyes level and your shoulders relaxed.
band protraction neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Place the band behind your head and anchor it behind you
2. Walk forward until there's tension, keeping a slight chin tuck
3. Hold your head still against the band for the set time
4. Step back to release

Tip
The more you lean forward, the harder it gets. Keep breathing.
band resisted alternating split stance p:
Steps
1. Attach bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet, switching legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Get off the floor as fast as you can with stiff ankles.
band resisted backwards walk:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your waist, anchored in front
2. Walk backward against the band
3. Take long strides
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
band resisted cat camel:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with a band over your back, held under your hands
2. Round your back up against the band
3. Then arch your back down
4. Repeat slowly

Tip
Move through the whole spine.
band resisted double broad jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your hips, anchored behind you
2. Swing your arms and jump forward
3. Land and jump forward again straight away
4. Stick the second landing

Tip
Load up quickly.
band resisted double contact counter mov:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Drop and jump
3. Land and jump again straight away
4. Stick the second landing

Tip
If you don't have pins, loop bands around heavy dumbbells.
band resisted lateral bound:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand on the leg closest to the anchor
3. Bound sideways away from the anchor
4. Stick the landing on the other leg

Tip
Keep your knee over your toes as you land.
band resisted lateral bound + return:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Bound sideways away from the anchor
3. Stick the landing
4. Bound back to the start

Tip
Loop the band around a pole if you don't have a partner.
band resisted lateral jump:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand on both feet
3. Jump sideways away from the anchor
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Stay low and push hard.
band resisted lateral pogo hop:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand on one leg
3. Hop side to side off the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankle.
band resisted lateral pogo jump:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce side to side off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankles.
band resisted lateral shuffle - continuo:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your waist, anchored to one side
2. Shuffle away from the anchor
3. Shuffle back
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low and punch the floor away.
band resisted lateral shuffle to base:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your waist, anchored to one side
2. Shuffle away from the anchor
3. Stop in an athletic base
4. Reset

Tip
A pole works if no partner is available.
band resisted pogo jump:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet with stiff legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Get off the floor as fast as you can.
band resisted pogo jump - fight stance -:
Steps
1. Set a band around your hips
2. Stand in your fight stance
3. Bounce forward and backward off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stay in your stance.
band resisted pogo jump side to side:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce side to side off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankles.
band resisted split stance pogo jump:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Get off the floor as fast as you can.
band resisted vertical jump:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Load up quickly.
band resisted vertical jump (cmj) - shou:
Steps
1. Set bands across your body over the opposite shoulder
2. Drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Load up quickly.
band retraction neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Place the band around your forehead, anchored in front of you
2. Walk back until there's tension, keeping your chin level
3. Hold your head still against the band for the set time
4. Step forward to release

Tip
Keep breathing and don't let your head get pulled forward.
band shoulder dislocation:
Steps
1. Hold a band in front of you with a wide grip
2. Keep your arms straight and lift the band overhead
3. Continue behind your back
4. Reverse back to the front

Tip
More slack helps if you lack mobility.
band standing row:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand
2. Stand tall with a soft bend in your knees and arms straight
3. Pull your elbows back past your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together
4. Slowly let your arms straighten

Tip
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
band wrist pronation - rack set up:
Steps
1. Anchor a band low on a rack and hold a dowel or handle with the band attached to one side
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, elbow at 90 degrees
3. Start palm up and rotate your palm down against the band
4. Slowly rotate back to palm up

Tip
The forearm stays still. Only the hand and wrist rotate.
band wrist supination - rig set up:
Steps
1. Anchor a band low on a rig and hold a dowel or handle with the band attached to one side
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, elbow at 90 degrees
3. Start palm down and rotate your palm up against the band
4. Slowly rotate back to palm down

Tip
Keep your elbow tucked and still.
band-resisted quasi-isometric 4-way neck:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your head, anchored to the front
2. Very slowly move your head against the band through a small range, taking 5 or more seconds each way
3. Repeat facing away, then each side, so you train all 4 directions
4. Keep tension on the band the whole time

Tip
Slow is the point. If you can move fast, the band is too light.
band-resisted trapbar drop jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar with bands attached
2. Drop into a quarter squat holding the bar
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Keep your chest up.
banded external rotations in genie posit:
Steps
1. Anchor a band in front of you at shoulder height
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your elbow at shoulder height.
banded iso shoulder external rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm out a little and hold that position against the band
4. Hold for the set time, then switch arms

Tip
Push at a steady effort. Don't let the elbow drift away from your side.
banded leg lower:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with both legs straight up and a band around one foot
2. Hold the band to support that leg
3. Lower the other leg slowly towards the floor
4. Lift it back and repeat

Tip
Keep your lower back on the floor.
banded neck backwards shuffle:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your forehead, held by a partner in front
2. Keep your head still
3. Shuffle backward against the band
4. Keep going

Tip
Don't let your head get pulled forward.
banded neck forward shuffle:
Steps
1. Loop a band around the back of your head, held by a partner behind
2. Keep your head still
3. Shuffle forward against the band
4. Keep going

Tip
Keep a slight chin tuck.
banded neck lateral iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around the side of your head above the ear
2. Step away until there's tension, standing side-on
3. Keep your head level and resist the band for the set time
4. Turn around and repeat on the other side

Tip
Breathe normally and keep your shoulders level.
banded neck protraction iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around the back of your head
2. Face away from the rack and step forward until there's tension
3. Keep a slight chin tuck and hold your head still for the set time
4. Step back to release

Tip
Lean forward more to make it harder.
banded neck retraction iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around your forehead
2. Face the rack and step back until there's tension
3. Keep your chin level and hold your head still for the set time
4. Step forward to release

Tip
Don't let the band pull your chin forward.
banded shoulder external rotation - adbu:
Steps
1. Anchor a band in front of you at shoulder height
2. Lift your arm out to the side so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Slowly lower back to the start

Tip
Your elbow stays at shoulder height the whole time.
banded thread the needle:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with a band anchored to one side
2. Hold the band in the far hand
3. Reach it under your body
4. Then rotate open and pull towards the ceiling

Tip
Reach for a deep stretch each rep.
banded worlds greatest stretch:
Steps
1. Step into a deep lunge with a band around your hips
2. Put the inside hand on the floor
3. Rotate and reach your other arm to the ceiling
4. Return and repeat

Tip
Keep your back knee off the floor.
barbell alternating split stance jump (c:
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Drop and jump, switching legs in the air
3. Land in the opposite split
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay upright and spend as little time on the floor as possible.
barbell behind the neck power jerk:
Steps
1. Hold the barbell on your back with a wide grip
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up hard and push yourself under the bar, catching it overhead in a quarter squat
4. Stand up and lower the bar back to your back

Tip
Keep the dip straight down, chest up.
barbell clean:
Steps
1. Set up with the bar over your mid-foot, clean-width grip, flat back
2. Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees
3. Extend your hips and knees hard and pull yourself under the bar
4. Catch it on your shoulders in a front squat, then stand up

Tip
Keep the bar close.
barbell counter movement jump (cmj):
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back
2. Drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Load up quickly.
barbell cuban press:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell with a shoulder-width grip, arms hanging
2. Upright row the bar until your elbows are at shoulder height
3. Rotate your forearms up so the bar is in front of your face, elbows still at shoulder height
4. Press the bar overhead
5. Reverse each step slowly to return

Tip
Use a light load. This is a shoulder health drill, not a strength lift.
barbell jump shrug:
Steps
1. Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean grip
2. Dip slightly by bending your knees
3. Jump and shrug hard
4. Land softly

Tip
Arms stay long.
barbell power clean:
Steps
1. Set up with the bar over your mid-foot, clean grip, flat back
2. Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees
3. Extend your hips and knees hard, then pull under
4. Catch the bar on your shoulders in a quarter squat

Tip
Keep the bar close.
barbell power clean from blocks - below:
Steps
1. Set the bar on blocks just below your knees
2. Set up with a clean grip and flat back
3. Extend hard and pull under
4. Catch on your shoulders in a quarter squat

Tip
This can be done on pins.
barbell power clean from pins - above kn:
Steps
1. Set the bar on pins just above your knees
2. Set up with a clean grip and flat back
3. Extend hard and pull under
4. Catch on your shoulders in a quarter squat

Tip
Keep the bar close.
barbell power jerk:
Steps
1. Hold the bar in the front rack
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up hard and push yourself under, catching the bar overhead in a quarter squat
4. Stand up and lower the bar to your shoulders

Tip
Re-rack in front of you unless prescribed otherwise.
barbell push jerk:
Steps
1. Hold the bar in the front rack
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up and push the bar overhead, dropping into a partial squat
4. Stand up and lower the bar to your shoulders

Tip
Drive through your legs.
barbell push press - split stance:
Steps
1. Hold the bar in the front rack in a split stance
2. Dip by bending your knees
3. Drive up and press the bar overhead
4. Lower to your shoulders

Tip
Use your legs to start the press.
barbell split squat jump:
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Lower into a split squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land in the same stance

Tip
Stay upright.
barbell split stance jump (cmj):
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Drop quickly and jump
3. Land in the same stance
4. Reset

Tip
Be explosive. Use a weight that moves fast.
barbell split stance squat jump (ncm):
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Lower and pause at the bottom
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
The pause removes the bounce.
barbell squat jump:
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back
2. Lower into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Keep your chest up.
barbell zercher shrug:
Steps
1. Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows, close to your body
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Shrug your shoulders straight up towards your ears
4. Pause, then lower slowly

Tip
Don't roll your shoulders. Straight up, straight down.
barefoot backward cycles:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Move backwards with a cycling leg action, reaching each foot back
3. Land on the front of your foot each step
4. Keep your steps light and controlled

Tip
Ease into it. Start with short distances.
barefoot dribble:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Take small, rapid steps forward, the ankle of the moving leg stepping over the other ankle
3. Land on the front and middle of the foot each time
4. Keep the foot active, not floppy

Tip
Quick turnover and light contacts.
barefoot in to outs:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Move forward, swinging each leg from the inside to the outside as you step
3. Land on the mid to forefoot each time
4. Keep the foot firm and the contacts light

Tip
Feel light and springy, not heavy.
barefoot out to in:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Move forward, swinging each leg from the outside to the inside as you step
3. Land on the mid to forefoot each time
4. Keep the foot firm and the contacts light

Tip
Feel light and springy, not heavy.
barefoot reach backs:
Steps
1. Stand tall, barefoot, on a soft surface
2. Walk or jog backwards, reaching each foot slightly behind you
3. Land on the front of your foot each step
4. Keep your chest up and your steps controlled

Tip
Short, smooth steps. Don't lean back.
barefoot single leg sweeps eyes closed:
Steps
1. Stand barefoot on one leg near a wall or rail
2. Close your eyes
3. Slowly sweep the other leg forward, out to the side and back, keeping your balance
4. Repeat, then switch legs

Tip
Open your eyes and grab support if you start to lose balance.
bear crawl with sit through:
Steps
1. Start on hands and feet with your knees just off the floor
2. Crawl forward a few steps
3. Lift one hand and thread the opposite leg through
4. Return and continue crawling

Tip
Keep your hips low.
bear squat:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with toes tucked
2. Lift your knees slightly off the floor
3. Push your hips back towards your heels
4. Return

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
behind the neck lat pulldown:
Steps
1. Sit at the pulldown with a wide grip and your thighs under the pad
2. Lean very slightly forward and pull the bar down behind your head towards the top of your neck
3. Keep your elbows pointing down, not back
4. Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight

Tip
Only go as low as your shoulders comfortably allow. Skip it if it pinches.
belt squat march:
Steps
1. Set up in the belt squat machine
2. Stand tall
3. March on the spot, lifting each knee
4. Keep going for the set time

Tip
Hands off the machine.
bench crossover stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench with one leg straight
2. Cross it over your body
3. Rotate the opposite shoulder and hip
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Keep your shoulders on the bench.
bench quad stretch + reach:
Steps
1. Kneel with your back foot on a bench behind you
2. Squeeze the glute of the back leg
3. Reach the same-side arm overhead
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Keep your chest tall.
bench tricep dip:
Steps
1. Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside your hips, fingers forward
2. Slide your hips off the bench with your legs out in front
3. Bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor
4. Press back up until your arms are straight

Tip
Keep your hips close to the bench and your shoulders down.
bent knee loaded toe walks:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells or kettlebells at your sides
2. Rise onto your toes with a slight bend in your knees
3. Walk forward with short steps, staying high on your toes
4. Keep the knees bent and the heels up the whole time

Tip
If your heels drop, the set is over.
bent knee toe walks:
Steps
1. Rise onto your toes with a slight bend in your knees
2. Walk forward with short steps, staying high on your toes
3. Keep the knees bent and the heels up the whole time
4. Stand tall with your trunk braced

Tip
If your heels drop, the set is over.
bird dog:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips
2. Brace your trunk so your back is flat
3. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body
4. Pause, return under control, then switch sides

Tip
Imagine balancing a glass of water on your lower back.
body weight bent knee calf raises:
Steps
1. Stand on the edge of a step or flat ground with your knees bent slightly
2. Keep that knee bend as you rise as high as you can onto your toes
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
This targets the soleus. Don't straighten your knees as you rise.
body weight calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding something for balance
2. Rise as high as you can onto the balls of your feet
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower your heels slowly to the ground

Tip
Push through your big toe. Don't roll to the outside of your foot.
body weight forward lunge:
Steps
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart
2. Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees
3. Keep your chest up and your front knee in line with your toes
4. Push through the front foot to step back to the start

Tip
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
bodyweight bent knee calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand with your knees bent slightly
2. Keep that knee bend as you rise as high as you can onto your toes
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
This targets the soleus. Don't straighten your knees as you rise.
bodyweight bent knee single leg calf rai:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent, holding something for balance
2. Keep the knee bend as you rise as high as you can onto your toes
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly, then switch legs after the set

Tip
Push through your big toe.
bodyweight deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your arms pointing to the ceiling and hips and knees at 90 degrees
2. Press your lower back gently into the floor
3. Slowly lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg towards the floor
4. Return to the start and switch sides

Tip
If your lower back lifts off the floor, shorten the range.
bodyweight outside leg calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg, holding something for balance
2. Rise onto your toes, pushing off the outside of your foot
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Push through the outside of your foot the whole way.
bodyweight rear foot elevated squat:
Steps
1. Stand about a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of your back foot on it
2. Lower straight down until your back knee is just above the floor
3. Keep your chest up and front knee tracking over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to stand up

Tip
Most of your weight stays on the front leg.
bodyweight split squat:
Steps
1. Stand in a long split stance, feet hip-width apart
2. Lower straight down until your back knee is just above the floor
3. Keep your chest up and front knee tracking over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to return to the top

Tip
Stay in the split stance for all reps, then switch.
bodyweight split squat jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a split stance
2. Lower into a split squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly in the same stance and reset

Tip
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
bottoms up kettlebell carry - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle, bell pointing up, elbow at 90 degrees
2. Squeeze the handle hard to keep the bell balanced
3. Walk forward with slow, controlled steps
4. Switch arms after the set distance

Tip
Keep your wrist straight and your shoulder down.
box jump:
Steps
1. Stand facing a box with your feet hip-width apart
2. Swing your arms back and drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump onto the box, landing softly in a quarter squat
4. Stand up and step down

Tip
Pick a height you can land on with your hips above your knees.
box squat to squat jump:
Steps
1. Sit back onto a box
2. Pause briefly
3. Drive up off the box and jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and sit back to the box

Tip
Keep your chest up.
boxing:
Steps
1. Work on bag, pads or shadow as prescribed
2. Keep your hands up and feet moving
3. Work the rounds at the intensity prescribed
4. Rest between rounds

Tip
Breathe out on every strike.
bretzel stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with the top knee bent in front of you
2. Reach back with your top hand to grab the bottom foot
3. Rotate your chest towards the ceiling
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Breathe into the stretch.
broad jump:
Steps
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
2. Swing your arms back and drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump forward as far as you can
4. Stick the landing in a quarter squat

Tip
Hold the landing for a second before resetting.
broad jump - (counter-movement):
Steps
1. Stand tall with your chest up and trunk braced
2. Drop quickly into a quarter squat as you swing your arms back
3. Jump forward as far as you can
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Load fast, jump straight away.
broad jump - alternating bound:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Bound forward, landing on the other leg
3. Bound again, switching legs
4. Stick the final landing

Tip
One bound on each side, or as prescribed.
burpee to sit through:
Steps
1. Drop into a push-up position
2. Thread one leg through under your body
3. Return to a push-up position
4. Jump your feet in and stand up

Tip
Keep it smooth.
cable - bayesian bicep curl:
Steps
1. Set the cable low and face away from it, holding the handle with your arm behind your body
2. Take a step forward so your arm is stretched behind you
3. Curl the handle up towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow behind your torso
4. Slowly lower back to the stretched position

Tip
Can do one side at a time if two cables aren't available.
cable - single arm shoulder extension -:
Steps
1. Set the cable high and hold the handle in one hand with your arm straight
2. Set your shoulder blades back and down
3. Pull your straight arm down and back in an I, then a Y, then a T direction
4. Return slowly after each rep

Tip
Light weight. Lead with the shoulder blade, not the hand.
cable assisted pancake stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs wide and a cable handle in your hands
2. Let the cable pull you forward
3. Hinge from your hips
4. Hold the stretch

Tip
A band works if no cable.
cable external rotations in genie positi:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height in front of you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm forward
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
Use a light weight and control both directions.
cable hip adduction:
Steps
1. Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and stand side-on with the strap on the inside leg
2. Hold the machine or a dowel for balance
3. Pull the strapped leg across in front of your standing leg
4. Slowly let it return out to the side

Tip
Stand tall and don't lean as you pull.
cable internal rotation in genie positio:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height behind you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing up
3. Rotate your forearm forward and down until it points forward
4. Control the cable as it returns

Tip
Elbow stays at shoulder height throughout.
cable iso external rotation:
Steps
1. Set the cable at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the stack
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm out slightly and hold it there against the cable
4. Hold for the set time, then switch arms

Tip
Keep a steady effort and don't let the elbow drift.
cable overhead rope tricep extension - e:
Steps
1. Attach a rope to a cable and face away, holding the rope behind your head
2. Let your elbows point out to the sides
3. Extend your arms forward and up until they're straight
4. Slowly bend your elbows to return

Tip
Keep your ribs down so your back doesn't arch.
cable overhead rope triceps extension -:
Steps
1. Attach a rope or handle low and face away, holding it behind your head in one hand
2. Point your elbow up
3. Straighten your arm overhead
4. Slowly bend the elbow to return, then switch arms

Tip
Keep the upper arm still. Only the forearm moves.
cable rope tricep extension:
Steps
1. Attach a rope to a high cable and hold the ends with your elbows tucked at your sides
2. Push the rope down until your arms are straight, spreading the ends apart at the bottom
3. Squeeze the triceps
4. Let the rope rise slowly to chest height

Tip
Your elbows stay pinned to your sides.
cable shoulder adduction - single arm:
Steps
1. Set the cable high beside you and hold the handle with your arm out to the side
2. Keep your chest up
3. Pull your arm down to your side, palm finishing towards your hip
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulder down away from your ear.
cable shoulder external rotation - abduc:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height in front of you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Slowly lower back to the start

Tip
Keep your elbow fixed and don't bend at the wrist.
cable shoulder internal rotation - abduc:
Steps
1. Set the cable at shoulder height behind you
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm up
3. Rotate your forearm forward and down
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
Keep your elbow fixed and don't bend at the wrist.
cable shoulder iso internal rotation:
Steps
1. Set the cable at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand closest to the stack
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees
3. Pull your forearm in slightly and hold against the cable
4. Hold for the set time, then switch arms

Tip
Steady effort, elbow pinned.
cable straight bar tricep pushdown:
Steps
1. Attach a straight bar to a high cable and grip it overhand, shoulder-width
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push the bar down until your arms are straight
4. Let it rise slowly to chest height

Tip
Don't lean over the bar. Stand tall.
cable tricep rope pushdown iso hold:
Steps
1. Attach a rope to a high cable and push it down until your arms are straight
2. Spread the rope ends apart at the bottom
3. Hold that position with the triceps squeezed for the set time
4. Let the rope rise slowly to finish

Tip
Keep tension in the triceps the whole hold.
cable y raise:
Steps
1. Set the cable low and stand side-on or facing it, holding the handle
2. Keep your arm straight with a thumb-up grip
3. Raise your arm up and out into a Y overhead
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your ribs down as you lift.
calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding something for balance if needed
2. Rise as high as you can onto the balls of your feet
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Push through the big toe.
calf stretch on a wall:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall in a split stance
2. Keep the back leg straight and heel down
3. Lean forward into the wall
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Keep the back heel grounded.
cat to cow:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips
2. Round your back up towards the ceiling, tucking your chin and tailbone (cat)
3. Slowly arch your back, lifting your chest and tailbone (cow)
4. Move slowly between the two with your breath

Tip
Move through the whole spine, one segment at a time.
chest supported db front raise:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells, arms hanging
2. Keep your arms straight with a slight bend in the elbow
3. Raise the dumbbells forward to about shoulder height
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your chest on the pad so you can't swing.
child's pose:
Steps
1. Kneel with your big toes together and knees apart
2. Sit your hips back towards your heels
3. Reach your arms forward and rest your forehead on the floor
4. Breathe slowly and hold

Tip
Let your back relax and sink with each breath out.
clean high pull from pins:
Steps
1. Set the bar on pins at the height prescribed and take a clean grip
2. Set a flat back
3. Extend hard through your hips and knees
4. Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high, then lower

Tip
Keep the bar close.
continuous lateral bound at 45 degrees:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Bound diagonally forward at 45 degrees onto the other leg
3. Bound straight back to the other side
4. Keep going for the set reps

Tip
Be quick off the floor and get height.
continuous plate lateral pogo hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a plate
2. Hop sideways over the plate and back
3. Stay on the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast, then switch

Tip
Stiff ankle.
continuous plate lateral pogo jump:
Steps
1. Stand on both feet beside a plate
2. Jump sideways over the plate and back
3. Stay on the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankles.
continuous plate medial pogo hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg on the outside of a plate
2. Hop inward over the plate and back
3. Stay on the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast, then switch

Tip
Stiff ankle.
continuous plate pogo hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg behind a plate
2. Hop forward over the plate and back
3. Stay on the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast, then switch

Tip
Stiff ankle.
continuous plate pogo jump:
Steps
1. Stand on both feet behind a plate
2. Jump forward over the plate and back
3. Stay on the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankles.
continuous single leg hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop forward
3. Land and hop again straight away
4. Complete the reps, then switch

Tip
Fast off the floor.
contralateral foam roller deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a foam roller between your hands and knees
2. Squeeze it
3. Lower one arm and the opposite leg
4. Return and switch sides

Tip
Keep the roller squeezed.
cook toe touch progression:
Steps
1. Stand with your heels on a plate and a block between your knees
2. Squeeze the block
3. Reach down to touch your toes
4. Return to standing

Tip
You can also elevate your toes.
counter movement high overhead medball s:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball with straight arms
2. Drop quickly into a squat, swinging the ball between your legs
3. Explode up and throw the ball as high as you can overhead
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
counter movement jump (cmj):
Steps
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart
2. Drop quickly into a quarter squat as you swing your arms back
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Load fast, jump straight away.
counter movement low overhead scoop thro:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball with straight arms
2. Drop quickly into a squat, swinging the ball between your legs
3. Explode up and throw the ball back over your head at a low angle
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
counter movement mid overhead medball sc:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball with straight arms
2. Drop quickly into a squat, swinging the ball between your legs
3. Explode up and throw the ball back over your head at about 45 degrees
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
counter-movement linear jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Drop quickly into a quarter squat as you swing your arms back
3. Jump forward
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Load fast, jump straight away.
crawl out:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Fold forward and walk your hands out to a push-up position
3. Walk your hands back
4. Stand up

Tip
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
cross bench dumbbell pullover:
Steps
1. Lie across a bench with your shoulders on it
2. Hold a dumbbell over your chest
3. Lower it behind your head
4. Pull it back over your chest

Tip
Big stretch in your lats.
curved run:
Steps
1. Set out a curve
2. Run along it at the speed prescribed
3. Lean into the curve
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay on the balls of your feet.
curved treadmill:
Steps
1. Step onto the curved treadmill
2. Start slow by moving your feet
3. Lean forward to speed up
4. Run at the intensity prescribed

Tip
Stand up tall to slow down.
cycling:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke
2. Start at an easy pace to warm up
3. Ride at the pace or intensity prescribed
4. Ease off for the last minute to cool down

Tip
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your cadence smooth.
daily mobility routine - cars:
Steps
1. Stand or sit tall
2. Move one joint through its biggest circle
3. Keep the rest of your body still
4. Move slowly, then reverse

Tip
Slow and controlled.
db goblet rocking cossack squat:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell at your chest with a wide stance
2. Shift your weight to one side
3. Sit low into that hip
4. Rock to the other side

Tip
Keep the straight leg's toes up.
dead ball over the shoulder:
Steps
1. Stand with the ball between your feet
2. Hinge and squat down to grab it with both hands
3. Drive through your legs and hips to lift it and throw it over one shoulder
4. Turn around, reset and repeat, alternating shoulders

Tip
Use your legs and hips, not your back.
decline tricep extensions:
Steps
1. Lie on a decline bench holding a bar or dumbbells above your chest
2. Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weight towards your forehead
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat with control

Tip
Keep your elbows pointing up, not flaring out.
deep tier - b-stance jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a B-stance: most weight on the front foot, back foot's toes on the floor beside the front heel
2. Sit deep into the hips
3. Jump up and land back in the same stance
4. Stay low for the next rep

Tip
Stay low the whole set.
deep tier - forward jump:
Steps
1. Sit into a deep squat
2. Jump forward a short distance
3. Land back in the deep squat
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier - front foot elevated (ffe) sp:
Steps
1. Set your front foot on a low plate or step in a split stance
2. Lower into a deep split squat
3. Jump and land in the same position
4. Repeat

Tip
Start low and build height.
deep tier - lateral bound reaches:
Steps
1. Sit low on one leg
2. Bound sideways onto the other leg
3. Land low and reach towards the floor
4. Bound back

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier - medball squat jump:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Sit into a deep squat
3. Jump and land back in the deep squat
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay low into the squat.
deep tier - rear foot elevated split squ:
Steps
1. Rest your back foot on a bench in a split stance
2. Lower into a deep split squat
3. Jump off the front leg and land in the same position
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier - side to side jump:
Steps
1. Sit into a deep squat
2. Jump a short distance sideways
3. Land back low and jump the other way
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier - staggered stance broad jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a staggered stance and sit deep into the hips
2. Jump forward
3. Land low in the same stance
4. Reset

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier alternating split squat jump -:
Steps
1. Lower into a deep split squat
2. Jump and switch legs in the air
3. Land low in the opposite split
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier forward + backwards jump - con:
Steps
1. Sit into a deep squat
2. Jump forward a short distance
3. Jump straight back
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier lateral jump - continuous:
Steps
1. Sit into a deep squat
2. Jump sideways
3. Land low and jump back
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier lateral split squat jumps - co:
Steps
1. Sit into a deep lateral lunge
2. Jump and switch to a lateral lunge on the other side
3. Land low
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier split squat jump - continuous:
Steps
1. Lower into a deep split squat
2. Jump and land in the same stance
3. Jump again straight away
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
deep tier squat jump - continuous:
Steps
1. Sit into a deep squat
2. Jump
3. Land back in the deep squat and jump again
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay as low as possible.
deficit kettlebell squat jump:
Steps
1. Stand on two boxes or plates with a kettlebell hanging between your feet
2. Squat down below the level of your feet
3. Jump up holding the kettlebell
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Plyo boxes work if available.
depth drop to box jump:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box
2. Step off and land on both feet
3. Jump straight up onto a second box in front
4. Step down and reset

Tip
Short ground contact.
depth drop to hurdle jump - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box with hurdles in front
2. Step off and land on both feet
3. Jump over each hurdle, one after the other
4. Land softly after the last

Tip
Start low: 12 to 20 inches for beginners.
depth drop to hurdle jump - single:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box with a hurdle in front
2. Step off and land on both feet
3. Jump straight over the hurdle
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Start low: 12 to 20 inches for beginners.
depth drop to lateral hurdle jump:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box with a hurdle beside the landing spot
2. Step off and land on both feet
3. Jump sideways over the hurdle
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Short ground contact.
depth drop to lateral hurdle jump to box:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box
2. Step off and land
3. Jump sideways over a hurdle
4. Then jump onto a box

Tip
Short contacts throughout.
depth drop to lateral jump:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box
2. Step off and land on both feet
3. Jump sideways as far as you can
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Short ground contact.
depth jump - single leg:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box on one leg
2. Step off and land on the same leg
3. Jump as high as you can straight away
4. Land softly, then switch

Tip
Start very low.
depth landing - single leg:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box on one leg
2. Step off
3. Land on the same leg in a quarter squat and stick it
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Knee over toes, hips back.
depth landing into split stance:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box
2. Step off
3. Land in a deep lunge position and stick it
4. Reset

Tip
Build up the height gradually.
donkey kick:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees
2. Keep one knee bent at 90 degrees and lift it up behind you, sole of the foot to the ceiling
3. Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back
4. Lower slowly and repeat, then switch legs

Tip
Brace your trunk so the movement comes from the hip.
door lat stretch:
Steps
1. Hold the door frame with both hands
2. Push your hips back
3. Let your chest drop
4. Hold

Tip
Feel the stretch along your side.
door posterior cuff stretch:
Steps
1. Put your arm across your body
2. Use the door frame to hold it in place
3. Turn your body away
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Keep your shoulder down.
double broad jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Broad jump forward
3. Land and jump forward again straight away
4. Stick the second landing

Tip
Be quick between jumps.
double contact box jump:
Steps
1. Stand facing a box
2. Do one small hop
3. Then jump straight onto the box
4. Step down

Tip
Be quick off the floor on the small hop.
double contact hurdle hop - lateral:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a hurdle
2. Do a small pop on the spot
3. Then hop sideways over the hurdle
4. Keep going over each hurdle

Tip
Be quick off the floor.
double contact hurdle hop - linear:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg behind a hurdle
2. Do a small pop on the spot
3. Then hop forward over the hurdle
4. Keep going over each hurdle

Tip
Be quick off the floor.
double contact hurdle hop - medial:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg on the outside of a hurdle
2. Do a small pop on the spot
3. Then hop inward over the hurdle
4. Keep going over each hurdle

Tip
Be quick off the floor.
double contact hurdle hop - medial + lat:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a hurdle
2. Pop on the spot, then hop over it
3. Pop, then hop back
4. Keep going

Tip
Fast off the floor while getting height.
double contact hurdle jump:
Steps
1. Stand behind a hurdle
2. Do a small pop on the spot
3. Then jump over the hurdle
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Fast off the floor while getting height.
double contact hurdle jump - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand behind a row of hurdles
2. Pop on the spot, then jump the first hurdle
3. Pop and jump each hurdle in turn
4. Land softly after the last

Tip
Fast off the floor, like it's lava.
double leg hamstring iso hold on bench -:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your heels on the edge of a bench, legs straight
2. Drive your heels into the bench and lift your hips
3. Hold a straight line from your heels to your shoulders
4. Hold for the set time, then lower

Tip
Squeeze your glutes and keep pushing through your heels.
dowel plate pull over:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a light plate or dowel over your chest
2. Lower it overhead
3. Pull it back over your chest
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
dowel radial deviation:
Steps
1. Stand holding a dowel near one end, arm at your side, dowel pointing forward
2. Keep your arm still and tilt the dowel up by bending at the wrist (thumb side)
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Hold further from the end to make it harder, closer to the middle to make it easier.
dowel ulnar deviation:
Steps
1. Stand holding a dowel near one end, arm at your side, dowel pointing behind you
2. Keep your arm still and tilt the dowel up behind you by bending at the wrist (little finger side)
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Hold further from the end to make it harder, closer to the middle to make it easier.
dowel wrist supination & pronation:
Steps
1. Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, holding a dowel upright near one end
2. Slowly rotate your palm down so the dowel moves to one side
3. Rotate back past upright until your palm faces up
4. Repeat with control

Tip
Keep your forearm still. Change your grip to adjust the difficulty.
downward dog w/ alternating toe touch:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position
2. Push your hips up and back into a downward dog, reaching your body away from the floor
3. Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot or shin
4. Return the hand and repeat on the other side

Tip
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
drop jump:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box
2. Step off and land on both feet
3. Jump as high as you can straight away
4. Land softly

Tip
Fast off the floor.
drop jump deep knee bend at contact:
Steps
1. Stand on a low box
2. Step off and land with a slight knee bend
3. Sink a little deeper, then jump as high as you can
4. Land softly

Tip
Slight knee bend on contact.
dumbbell alternating cross body hammer c:
Steps
1. Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in
2. Curl one dumbbell up across your body towards the opposite shoulder
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat with the other arm

Tip
Keep your elbow by your side and don't swing.
dumbbell alternating hammer curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in
2. Curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping the palm facing in
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat with the other arm

Tip
Keep your elbows by your sides.
dumbbell alternating iso lateral raise:
Steps
1. Raise both dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height
2. Hold one arm there while you lower and raise the other
3. Switch so the other arm holds while the first one works
4. Keep alternating for the set reps

Tip
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down.
dumbbell bent over shrug:
Steps
1. Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with arms hanging
2. Pull your shoulder blades back and together without bending your elbows
3. Pause, then let them spread apart
4. Repeat

Tip
Small movement. Arms stay straight.
dumbbell bicep curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward
2. Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly until your arms are straight

Tip
Keep your elbows by your sides and don't swing.
dumbbell bicep curl - drop catch:
Steps
1. Curl a dumbbell to the top position
2. Let go of it briefly so it drops
3. Quickly catch it partway down and stop it
4. Curl it back up and repeat

Tip
Use a light weight. The goal is a fast catch.
dumbbell bicep curl to overhead triceps:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Curl them up to your shoulders
3. Press them overhead, then lower them behind your head by bending your elbows
4. Extend back up, bring them to your shoulders and lower to your sides

Tip
Brace your trunk so your back doesn't arch overhead.
dumbbell box jump:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells at your sides facing a box
2. Drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump onto the box
4. Step down

Tip
Land with your hips above your knees.
dumbbell bulgarian split squat:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand about a stride in front of a bench
2. Rest the top of your back foot on the bench
3. Lower until your back knee is just above the floor, front knee tracking over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to stand up

Tip
Most of your weight stays on the front leg.
dumbbell counter movement jump (cmj) - c:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells at your sides
2. Drop into a quarter squat and jump
3. Land and jump again straight away
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay tall.
dumbbell counter movement jump (cmj) - s:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells at your sides
2. Drop into a quarter squat and jump
3. Land softly
4. Reset

Tip
Stay tall.
dumbbell depth jump:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells and stand on a low box
2. Step off and land on both feet
3. Jump as high as you can straight away
4. Land softly

Tip
Start low with light weights.
dumbbell drop landing:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding light dumbbells at your sides
2. Rise onto your toes, then quickly drop your hips into a quarter squat
3. Stick the landing and stop dead
4. Stand up and reset

Tip
Don't let your body keep sinking after you land.
dumbbell forward lunge:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides
2. Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees
3. Keep your chest up and front knee in line with your toes
4. Push through the front foot to step back

Tip
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
dumbbell genie external rotation - incli:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell
2. Lift your elbow to shoulder height with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm hanging
3. Rotate your forearm up until it's level with your body
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Rotate from the shoulder joint. The elbow stays put.
dumbbell goblet carry:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands
2. Stand tall with your elbows tucked
3. Walk with controlled steps for the set distance or time
4. Keep the weight close and your trunk braced

Tip
Don't lean back.
dumbbell hammer to supinated curl:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in
2. Curl up with palms in
3. At the top, rotate your palms to face you
4. Lower slowly, rotating back to palms in

Tip
Elbows stay by your sides.
dumbbell incline bicep curl - externally:
Steps
1. Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging, palms forward
2. Turn your arms out slightly so your palms face a little outwards
3. Curl the dumbbells up, keeping your elbows behind your body
4. Lower slowly to full stretch

Tip
Don't let your shoulders roll forward.
dumbbell lateral raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
2. With a slight bend in your elbows, raise them out to the sides to shoulder height
3. Pause briefly
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down.
dumbbell pec fly stretch on foam roller:
Steps
1. Lie on a foam roller along your spine holding light dumbbells over your chest
2. Open your arms out to the sides
3. Hold the stretch at the bottom
4. Return

Tip
Keep tension at the bottom.
dumbbell pinch grip hold:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell by the end of the head with your fingertips and thumb
2. Stand tall with your arm by your side
3. Hold for the set time
4. Switch hands

Tip
Squeeze as hard as you can.
dumbbell power jerk:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your shoulders
2. Dip quickly by bending your knees
3. Drive up and push yourself under the dumbbells, catching them overhead in a quarter squat
4. Stand up and lower them

Tip
Quick dip and punch your head through your arms.
dumbbell push press:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your shoulders
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up and press the dumbbells overhead
4. Lower to your shoulders

Tip
Use your legs to start the press.
dumbbell release counter movement jump (:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells
2. Drop into a quarter squat and let go of the dumbbells at the bottom
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly

Tip
Release cleanly and keep your feet clear.
dumbbell reverse curl:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing back
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders, keeping your palms facing down
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your wrists straight.
dumbbell reverse lunge:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides
2. Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees
3. Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to step back to the start

Tip
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
dumbbell rolling tricep extension on ben:
Steps
1. Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in
2. Bend your elbows and let the dumbbells roll back beside your head, elbows drifting back
3. Bring your elbows forward and press the dumbbells back over your chest
4. Repeat

Tip
Control the lowering.
dumbbell scaption raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, thumbs pointing up
2. Raise your arms at about 30 degrees in front of your sides (a shallow V)
3. Lift to shoulder height
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
dumbbell seated front raise:
Steps
1. Sit tall on a bench holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Keep your arms straight with a slight bend in your elbows
3. Raise the dumbbells forward to shoulder height
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Don't lean back.
dumbbell single arm bicep curl:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward
2. Curl it up towards your shoulder
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly, then switch arms after the set

Tip
Elbow stays by your side.
dumbbell single arm push press:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up and press it overhead
4. Lower to your shoulder, then switch

Tip
Brace so you don't lean.
dumbbell single arm shrug:
Steps
1. Hold a dumbbell in one hand at your side
2. Shrug that shoulder straight up towards your ear
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides after the set

Tip
Don't lean to the other side.
dumbbell single arm tricep kickback:
Steps
1. Hinge forward with one hand on a bench and a dumbbell in the other hand
2. Pull your elbow up beside your ribs and keep it there
3. Straighten your arm back until it's in line with your body
4. Bend the elbow slowly to return

Tip
Only your forearm moves.
dumbbell single leg counter movement jum:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells and stand on one leg
2. Drop and jump
3. Land and jump again straight away
4. Switch legs after the set

Tip
Knee over toes on landing.

1. Hold light dumbbells and stand on one leg
2. Drop and jump
3. Land softly and reset
4. Switch legs after the set

Tip
Knee over toes on landing.
dumbbell skull crusher:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in
2. Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat

Tip
Elbows point to the ceiling the whole time.
dumbbell spider curl:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down holding dumbbells
2. Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly to straight arms

Tip
Keep your upper arms vertical.
dumbbell split jerk:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your shoulders
2. Dip by bending your knees
3. Drive up and split your feet, catching the dumbbells overhead
4. Bring your feet back together and lower

Tip
Front foot steps forward, back foot steps back.
dumbbell split stance alternating pogo j:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells in a split stance
2. Bounce off the balls of your feet, switching legs
3. Keep your legs stiff
4. Keep going

Tip
Be fast off the floor.
dumbbell split stance jump:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells in a split stance
2. Drop and jump
3. Land in the same stance
4. Reset

Tip
Stay upright.
dumbbell split stance pogo jump:
Steps
1. Hold light dumbbells in a split stance
2. Bounce off the balls of your feet
3. Keep your legs stiff
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stay upright.
dumbbell standing shoulder press:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward or facing in
2. Brace your trunk and squeeze your glutes
3. Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight
4. Lower slowly to your shoulders

Tip
Don't arch your lower back.
dumbbell step up:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot fully on a box or bench
2. Drive through that foot to stand up on the box
3. Bring the other foot up, then step down with control
4. Repeat

Tip
Push through the top leg. Don't push off the bottom foot.
dumbbell strict curl:
Steps
1. Stand with your back against a wall or post, holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
The wall stops you swinging. Keep your back on it.
dumbbell sumo squat:
Steps
1. Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, holding one dumbbell vertically between your legs
2. Sit your hips down, keeping your chest up
3. Push your knees out over your toes
4. Drive up through your heels to stand

Tip
Keep your back flat.
dumbbell tall landing - double leg:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding light dumbbells
2. Rise onto your toes
3. Drop quickly into a quarter squat and stick it
4. Stand up and reset

Tip
Don't let your body keep sinking.
dumbbell tall landing - single leg:
Steps
1. Stand tall on one leg holding light dumbbells
2. Rise onto your toes, then drop quickly into a small knee bend
3. Stick the landing and hold it still
4. Reset and repeat, then switch legs

Tip
Land quietly with your knee over your toes.
dumbbell wrist extension:
Steps
1. Sit with your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm facing down, wrist over the edge
2. Hold a light dumbbell
3. Lift the back of your hand up towards the ceiling
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Only the wrist moves.
dumbbell wrist flexion:
Steps
1. Sit with your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm facing up, wrist over the edge
2. Hold a light dumbbell
3. Curl your wrist up
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Only the wrist moves.
elbow downward dog:
Steps
1. Start on your forearms and knees
2. Lift your knees and push your hips up
3. Push your chest towards your knees
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
elbow plank:
Steps
1. Lie face down and place your elbows under your shoulders
2. Lift your body so you're on your forearms and toes
3. Hold a straight line from your head to your heels
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Squeeze your glutes and don't let your hips sag.
elbow plank + rotation:
Steps
1. Start in an elbow plank
2. Rotate onto one elbow
3. Reach your top arm to the ceiling
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your hips up.
elbow side plank:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked
2. Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line
3. Hold for the set time
4. Switch sides

Tip
Don't let your hips drop or rotate.
elbow tap:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders
2. Separate your feet a little for balance
3. Lift one hand and tap the opposite elbow
4. Put it down and repeat on the other side

Tip
Keep a flat back and your hips still.
elbows out triceps extension:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at your chest, elbows pointing out to the sides
2. Keep your elbows fixed and press the dumbbells up and out until your arms are straight
3. Lower slowly back to your chest
4. Repeat

Tip
Elbows stay in the same spot as you press.
elephant walk:
Steps
1. Stand and fold forward, holding your legs
2. Bend one knee while straightening the other
3. Alternate
4. Keep going

Tip
Grab higher on your leg if your hamstrings are tight.
elevated staggered stance trapbar jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar on low platforms in a staggered stance
2. Drop slightly
3. Jump as high as you can holding the bar
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Keep your chest up.
elevated trap bar clean pull:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar on low platforms
2. Set a flat back
3. Explode up into full extension through your ankles, knees and hips
4. Lower with control

Tip
Arms stay long.
extensive alternating split stance pogo:
Steps
1. Stand in a split stance
2. Bounce off the balls of your feet, switching legs
3. Keep your knees nearly straight
4. Keep a steady rhythm

Tip
Fast off the floor.

Steps

2. Push the ball out
3. Catch it and repeat
4. Keep a steady rhythm
