lateral hurdle hop - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a hurdle
2. Hop sideways over it
3. Hop back straight away
4. Keep going, then switch

Tip
Quick contacts.
lateral hurdle jump to box jump:
Steps
1. Stand beside a hurdle
2. Jump sideways over it
3. Land and jump onto a box
4. Step down

Tip
Short contact between jumps.
lateral jump & stick:
Steps
1. Stand on both feet
2. Jump sideways as far as you can
3. Stick the landing
4. Reset

Tip
Hips back, knees over toes.
lateral jump - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on both feet
2. Jump sideways
3. Land and jump back straight away
4. Keep going

Tip
Quick off the floor.
lateral leg swing:
Steps
1. Face a wall with your hands on it for support
2. Swing one leg across in front of your body, then out to the side
3. Gradually increase the range
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your trunk still. The swing comes from the hip.
lateral pogo hop - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop side to side off the ball of your foot
3. Keep your knee nearly straight
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stiff ankle, quick contacts.
lateral shuffle:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle sideways
3. Keep your feet apart
4. Go back the other way

Tip
Keep your weight even on your feet.
lateral shuffle - 2 up 1 back:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle two steps one way
3. Then one back
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
lateral shuffle to crossover sprint:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle a few steps
3. Cross over and sprint
4. Walk back

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
lateral shuffle to linear hop to stick:
Steps
1. Stand in an athletic stance
2. Shuffle sideways a few steps
3. Hop forward on one leg
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
lateral shuffle to sprint:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle a few steps
3. Turn and sprint
4. Walk back

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
lateral sled power shuffle:
Steps
1. Attach a sled to a harness, side-on
2. Shuffle sideways with powerful steps
3. Keep going for the set distance
4. Switch sides

Tip
Powerful steps.
lateral sled sprint:
Steps
1. Attach a sled to a harness, side-on
2. Cross over and sprint sideways
3. Keep going for the set distance
4. Switch sides

Tip
Drive hard.
laying band groin stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a band around one foot
2. Let the leg fall out to the side
3. Hold the stretch
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your hips flat.
laying quad stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your side
2. Bend your top knee and hold your foot
3. Pull your heel towards your glute
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Squeeze your glute.
laying static groin:
Steps
1. Lie on your back
2. Put the soles of your feet together
3. Let your knees fall out
4. Hold

Tip
Breathe and relax.
lean fall sprint:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Slowly lean forward from your ankles
3. Just before you fall, sprint
4. Sprint the set distance

Tip
Stay tall as you lean.
leg press throw:
Steps
1. Sit in the leg press with a light load
2. Lower the sled
3. Push explosively so the sled leaves your feet
4. Catch it with soft knees

Tip
Only use a machine designed for this. Light load.
linear accel to lateral shuffle:
Steps
1. Accelerate forward a few steps
2. Stop and shuffle sideways
3. Keep going as prescribed
4. Reset

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
linear bound + stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Bound forward onto the other leg
3. Stick the landing and hold
4. Reset

Tip
Knee over toes.
linear hurdle hop - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg behind a row of hurdles
2. Hop over each hurdle in turn
3. Keep the contacts short
4. Switch legs

Tip
Quick off the floor.
linear hurdle hop to lateral bound:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg behind a hurdle
2. Hop over it
3. Land and bound sideways onto the other leg
4. Stick it

Tip
Quick contacts.
linear lateral bound:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Bound forward and to the side onto the other leg
3. Keep bounding forward, side to side
4. Stick the last landing

Tip
Increase the side-to-side distance as you get comfortable.
linear tuck jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Jump forward, pulling your knees to your chest
3. Land and go straight into the next jump
4. Keep going

Tip
Land on the balls of your feet.
loaded ankle dorsiflexion stretch:
Steps
1. Half kneel with a weight on your front knee
2. Rock your knee forward over your toes
3. Keep your heel down
4. Hold

Tip
A dumbbell or kettlebell works.
loaded deadbug reach - tabletop:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a weight over your chest
2. Lift your knees to 90 degrees
3. Reach the weight towards the ceiling
4. Hold

Tip
Breathe out as you reach.
loaded hip switch:
Steps
1. Sit in a 90/90 position holding a weight at your chest
2. Rotate your knees to the other side
3. Keep your chest tall
4. Keep going

Tip
Move slowly.
loaded pancake straddle good morning:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs wide holding a light weight
2. Hinge forward from your hips
3. Return to tall
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your back flat.
lower calf stretch:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall in a split stance with both hands on the wall
2. Bend both knees, keeping the back heel on the floor
3. Lean in until you feel a stretch low in the back calf
4. Hold, then switch legs

Tip
The bent knee targets the lower calf (soleus).
lying dumbbell tricep extension - double:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in
2. Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your elbows fixed and pointing up.
lying piriformis stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with both knees bent
2. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee
3. Pull the bottom thigh towards your chest
4. Hold, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
machine seated calf raise:
Steps
1. Sit in the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad on your thighs
2. Release the safety
3. Let your heels drop for a stretch, then rise as high as you can
4. Pause at the top and lower slowly

Tip
Push through the big toe.
machine seated single leg calf raise:
Steps
1. Sit in the machine with one foot on the platform and the pad on that thigh
2. Release the safety
3. Let your heel drop, then rise as high as you can
4. Pause at the top and lower slowly, then switch legs

Tip
Push through the big toe.
machine standing 2 up 1 down calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand in the machine on the balls of both feet with the pads on your shoulders
2. Rise up with both legs
3. Take one foot off and lower slowly on the other leg
4. Put the foot back and repeat

Tip
Push off the ball of your big toe.
machine standing calf raise - single leg:
Steps
1. Stand in the machine on the ball of one foot, pads on your shoulders
2. Let your heel drop for a stretch
3. Rise as high as you can
4. Lower slowly, then switch legs

Tip
Push through the ball of the big toe.
mcgill curl up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight
2. Slide your hands under the arch of your lower back
3. Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor without bending your neck
4. Hold for 5 to 10 seconds, then lower

Tip
Keep tension through the abs the whole time. Switch the bent leg halfway.
med ball chest pass:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall with a med ball at your chest
2. Push it into the wall as hard as you can
3. Catch it
4. Repeat

Tip
Extend fully through your arms.
med ball rotational throw:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a wall with a med ball at your back hip
2. Rotate through your hips
3. Throw the ball into the wall
4. Catch and repeat

Tip
Power comes from the hips.
med ball slam:
Steps
1. Stand holding a med ball overhead
2. Slam it into the floor as hard as you can
3. Pick it up
4. Repeat

Tip
Use your whole body.
medball around the worlds:
Steps
1. Stand holding a med ball overhead
2. Circle it around your head and body
3. Move through your full range
4. Reverse direction

Tip
Stay in control.
medball chest throw to sprint:
Steps
1. Stand holding a med ball at your chest
2. Throw it forward as hard as you can
3. Sprint after it straight away
4. Walk back

Tip
Lean forward into the throw.
medball deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a med ball over your chest
2. Lift your knees to 90 degrees
3. Lower one leg towards the floor
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
medball drop push press:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Drop quickly into a quarter squat
3. Drive up and throw the ball straight up
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
medball hip airplane:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg holding a med ball
2. Hinge forward
3. Rotate your hips open, then close them
4. Return

Tip
Focus on control, not speed.
medball push press:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Dip by bending your knees
3. Drive up and throw the ball straight up
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
medball rear foot elevated (rfe) split s:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball with your back foot on a bench
2. Lower into a split squat
3. Rotate towards your front leg
4. Return and stand

Tip
Keep your chest up.
medball shock push press:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball overhead
2. Drop it to your chest and catch it
3. Immediately drive up and throw it straight up
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
medball squat jump:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Lower into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly

Tip
Keep the ball tight to your chest.
medball thoracic extension + lateral fle:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball overhead
2. Extend your upper back
3. Bend to one side
4. Return and switch

Tip
Move slowly.
medball thoracic extension + rotation:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball overhead
2. Extend your upper back
3. Rotate to one side
4. Return and switch

Tip
Move slowly.
medial hurdle hop & stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg on the outside of a hurdle
2. Hop inward over it
3. Stick the landing on the same leg
4. Reset

Tip
Knee over toes.
medial pogo hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop inward and back off the ball of your foot
3. Keep your knee nearly straight
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stiff ankle.
medial to lateral hop & stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a hurdle
2. Hop inward over it
3. Hop straight back out and stick it
4. Reset

Tip
A yoga block or foam roller works as a hurdle.
middle splits - assisted:
Steps
1. Stand with your legs wide holding support
2. Slide your feet out
3. Go as far as is comfortable
4. Hold

Tip
Use as much assistance as you need.
middle splits - slider:
Steps
1. Stand with your feet on sliders
2. Slide your feet out
3. Go as far as you can comfortably slide back in
4. Return

Tip
Use your hands for support.
mini band clamshell:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with a mini band above your knees, hips and knees bent
2. Keep your feet together
3. Lift your top knee as high as you can without rolling back
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your hips stacked.
mini band glute bridge:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a mini band above your knees, feet flat
2. Push your knees out against the band
3. Drive through your heels to lift your hips
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower

Tip
Keep your knees pushed out the whole time.
mini band lateral squat walk (ankles):
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your ankles
2. Sit into a quarter squat
3. Step sideways, keeping tension on the band
4. Take the set number of steps, then go the other way

Tip
Stay low and don't let your feet come together.
mini band lateral squat walk (knees):
Steps
1. Place a mini band just above your knees
2. Sit into a quarter squat
3. Step sideways, keeping tension on the band
4. Take the set number of steps, then go the other way

Tip
Stay low and keep your knees pushed out.
mini band squat:
Steps
1. Place a mini band just above your knees
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart
3. Squat down, pushing your knees out against the band
4. Stand up, keeping the knees out

Tip
Don't let your knees cave in.
mini hurdle - linear to lateral jump:
Steps
1. Set two mini hurdles in an L
2. Jump forward over the first
3. Jump sideways over the second
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Quick contacts.
mini hurdle hop - linear to lateral to m:
Steps
1. Set mini hurdles in a pattern
2. On one leg, hop forward, then sideways out, then sideways in
3. Keep the contacts short
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stay balanced.
mini hurdle jump - linear to lateral to:
Steps
1. Set mini hurdles in a pattern
2. Jump forward, then sideways out, then sideways back
3. Keep the contacts short
4. Stick the last landing

Tip
Stay balanced.
miniband - serratus lift:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists and your forearms on a wall
2. Push your wrists apart against the band
3. Slide your forearms up the wall
4. Lift them slightly off the wall at the top, then return

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
miniband eversion:
Steps
1. Sit with a mini band around your feet, heels on the floor
2. Keep one foot still
3. Turn the other foot outwards against the band
4. Return slowly, then switch

Tip
Move only at the ankle.
miniband external rotation + iso hold:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Set your shoulder blades down and back
3. Rotate your forearms out against the band and hold for the set time
4. Return slowly

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband external rotation iso hold:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Set your shoulder blades down and back
3. Pull your hands apart and hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband hip flexion - wall leaning:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your feet and lean your back against a wall
2. Stand on one leg
3. Drive the other knee up to hip height against the band
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Stay tall against the wall.
miniband lateral walk:
Steps
1. Put a mini band around your legs
2. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
3. Step sideways
4. Keep tension on the band

Tip
Stay low.
miniband lateral walk - double banded:
Steps
1. Put one mini band above your knees and one at your ankles
2. Stand in a quarter squat
3. Step sideways
4. Keep tension on both bands

Tip
Stay low.
miniband shoulder abduction:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists
2. Stand tall with arms by your sides
3. Lift one arm out to the side against the band
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Keep your shoulder down away from your ear.
miniband shoulder external rotation:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Rotate one forearm out against the band
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband walk - backwards:
Steps
1. Put a mini band around your legs
2. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
3. Walk backward
4. Keep tension on the band

Tip
Stay low.
miniband walk - forwards:
Steps
1. Put a mini band around your legs
2. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
3. Walk forward
4. Keep tension on the band

Tip
Stay low.
muay thai - heavy bag 50 kicks drill:
Steps
1. Stand in your fight stance at the bag
2. Kick as fast as you can
3. Swing the arm on the kicking side
4. Keep going for 50 kicks

Tip
Turn your hip over.
muscle clean:
Steps
1. Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean grip
2. Extend hard through your hips and knees
3. Pull the bar up and turn your elbows over without dropping under it
4. Finish with the bar on your shoulders, legs straight

Tip
Keep the bar close.
natera ankle iso ballistic:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar or in a calf raise machine on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
2. Push up into the bar hard
3. Perform small, rapid bounces against the bar from that position
4. Keep the heel high throughout, then switch legs

Tip
Small range, maximum speed.
natera ankle iso push:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
2. Push up into the bar as hard as you can
3. Hold the effort for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
This can be swapped for a standing calf raise machine or a Smith machine.
natera ankle iso switch:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar on the balls of your feet in a sprint stance, heels just off the floor
2. Push into the bar
3. Quickly switch your legs, keeping the heels high
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Don't let your heels drop as you switch.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - hammer:
Steps
1. Stand in the calf raise machine on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent
2. Lift the load until your heel is just off the platform
3. Hold that position for the set time without letting the heel sink
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. The aim is to resist the weight, not lift it.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - hand su:
Steps
1. Put a safety bar on your back and hold a rack for support
2. Stand on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
3. Hold that position for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. Don't let the heel sink.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - smith m:
Steps
1. Set the Smith bar on your back and stand on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent
2. Lift the heel just off the floor
3. Hold that position for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. Don't let the heel sink.
neck circles off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench with your head and neck off the end
2. Slowly draw a big circle with your head
3. Complete the reps, then circle the other way
4. Keep your shoulders on the bench

Tip
If your neck pinches in a spot, draw a smaller circle.
neck extension:
Steps
1. Hinge forward or lie face down with your head free
2. Lower your chin towards your chest
3. Lift your head back until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Smooth reps through a comfortable range.
neck extension iso hold with weight plat:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on the back of your head with both hands
3. Keep your head in line with your spine
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Start light. Keep breathing.
neck extension off bench:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head fold forward for a stretch
3. Lift your head back until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Get a big stretch at the bottom.
neck flexion:
Steps
1. Lie on your back or sit tall
2. Tuck your chin
3. Bring your chin towards your chest
4. Return slowly

Tip
Smooth reps through a comfortable range.
neck flexion iso hold with weight plate:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on your forehead with both hands
3. Keep your head level with your body
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Start light. Keep breathing.
neck flexion off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head lower back for a stretch
3. Pull your chin towards your collarbone
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Get a big stretch at the bottom of each rep.
neck lateral flexion off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on your side on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head lower towards the floor
3. Lift your ear towards your top shoulder
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Get a big stretch between reps.
oblique crunch + adductor squeeze:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a ball between your knees
2. Squeeze the ball
3. Crunch up and across to one side
4. Lower and switch

Tip
Keep squeezing the ball.
offset dumbbell deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a dumbbell in one hand over your chest
2. Lift your knees to 90 degrees
3. Lower one leg towards the floor
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
offset dumbbell sit up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a dumbbell in one hand
2. Sit up
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Don't pull on your neck.
offset dumbbell straight leg sit up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your legs straight, holding a dumbbell in one hand
2. Sit up
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your legs on the floor.
offset hollow hold:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a dumbbell in one hand
2. Press your lower back into the floor
3. Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
open book:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with your knees bent
2. Reach your arms forward
3. Rotate your top arm open to the other side
4. Return

Tip
Breathe out and go as far as is comfortable.
open gate hip skips:
Steps
1. Skip forward
2. Lift one knee up and rotate it out to the side, like opening a gate
3. Land and repeat on the other leg
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay tall.
overcoming isometric to intensive rotati:
Steps
1. Stand side-on with a med ball against a fixed object or partner
2. Push into it as hard as you can for a few seconds
3. Release and scoop the ball into the wall as hard as you can
4. Reset

Tip
Max effort on both parts.
overhead dumbbell lateral raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides
2. Raise them out to the sides, past shoulder height, until they meet overhead
3. Lower slowly the same way
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your ribs down so your back doesn't arch.
overhead medball scoop throw from floor:
Steps
1. Stand over a med ball
2. Squat down and grab it
3. Explode up and throw it back over your head
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
overhead medball throw to wall:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall holding a med ball overhead
2. Step in and throw it into the wall
3. Catch it
4. Repeat

Tip
Use your whole body.
overhead plate double switch:
Steps
1. Hold a plate overhead with straight arms
2. Stand in the A position: one knee up at hip height, standing on the ball of the other foot
3. Switch legs twice quickly
4. Hold the A position, then repeat

Tip
Stay tall with the plate overhead.
overhead plate single leg switch:
Steps
1. Hold a plate overhead with straight arms
2. Stand in the A position: one knee up at hip height, standing on the ball of the other foot
3. Switch legs once quickly and hold
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay upright.
overhead rotational medball throw to wal:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a wall holding a med ball overhead
2. Rotate and throw it into the wall
3. Catch it
4. Repeat, then switch sides

Tip
Rotate through your hips.
pails/rails - frog stretch:
Steps
1. Kneel with your knees wide in a frog stretch
2. Press your knees into the floor for 10 seconds (PAILs)
3. Then try to lift them for 10 seconds (RAILs)
4. Relax

Tip
Squeeze the floor and hold.
pails/rails - hamstring on box:
Steps
1. Put your heel on a box with your leg straight
2. Press your heel into the box for 10 seconds (PAILs)
3. Then try to lift it for 10 seconds (RAILs)
4. Relax

Tip
Build up to 2 to 3 rounds.
pails/rails - hip 90 90:
Steps
1. Sit in a 90/90 position
2. Press your front shin into the floor for 10 seconds (PAILs)
3. Then try to lift it for 10 seconds (RAILs)
4. Relax

Tip
Hold the contraction.
pallof press:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a band or cable at chest height
2. Hold it at your chest
3. Press it straight out, resisting rotation
4. Bring it back in

Tip
Stay tall and don't twist.
partial dumbbell lateral raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Raise them out to the sides through the bottom half of the range only
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep constant tension. Don't rest at the bottom.
pec deck fly machine - end-range iso hol:
Steps
1. Set up in the pec deck
2. Open your arms to the stretched position
3. Hold there for the set time
4. Return

Tip
Keep tension at the end range.
pinch grip drop catch:
Steps
1. Hold a plate in a pinch grip at your side
2. Let go of it
3. Catch it in a pinch grip before it hits the floor
4. Reset and repeat

Tip
Use a light plate and keep your feet clear.
pinch grip drop catch - alternating:
Steps
1. Hold a plate in a pinch grip in one hand
2. Drop it and catch it with the other hand
3. Keep alternating hands
4. Catch it before it hits the floor

Tip
Use a light plate and keep your feet clear.
pinch grip dumbbell hammer curls:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells by the end of the head in a pinch grip, palms facing in
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep the pinch tight throughout.
plate chest opener - medball supported:
Steps
1. Lie with your upper back on a med ball holding a light plate
2. Lower it overhead
3. Hold the stretch
4. Return

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
plate deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a plate over your chest
2. Lift your knees to 90 degrees
3. Lower one leg towards the floor
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
plate genie external rotation - barbell:
Steps
1. Set a barbell in the rack at or just below shoulder height
2. Rest your upper arm on the bar, elbow at 90 degrees, holding a light plate
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Elbow stays on the bar.
plate hip airplane:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg holding a plate
2. Hinge forward
3. Rotate your hips open, then close them
4. Return

Tip
A bar or weight tree works for support.
plate kang squat:
Steps
1. Hold a plate at your chest
2. Hinge forward
3. Squat down
4. Return

Tip
Keep your back flat.
plate neck extension:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on the back of your head
3. Lift your head until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Start light.

single arm ring row + rotation:

Lead with your chest.
single arm split stance band row with ro:

Lead with your chest.
single leg a skip:

Stay tall.
single leg box blast:
Steps
1. Stand with one foot on a box

Drive through the top leg.
single leg box blast with knee drive:

Stay tall.
single leg box jump:

Start with a low box.
single leg broad jump with double leg la:

Stick the landing.
single leg double broad jump:

Fast contact off the floor.
single leg glute bridge:

Don't let your hips tilt.
single leg heel tap - table top:

Keep your lower back flat.
single leg lateral zig zog pogo hop:

Stiff ankle.
single leg lower - table top:

Keep your lower back flat.
single leg skater squat:

Reach your arms forward for balance.
single leg vertical jump:

Knee over toes on landing.
single mini hurdle jump:
Steps

Raise the hurdle to make it harder.
sit through:

Retract your shoulder blades.
sit up to stand up:

skierg:

skipping:

4. Keep a steady rhythm

Small, quick jumps.
sl rdl to close gate - dowel:

sled bound:

Be explosive with each step.
sled march:

sled push:
Steps
1. Lean into a sled with your arms straight

Stay low.
smith machine bench throw:

1. Lie on a bench under a Smith bar with a light load

4. Catch it and lower

Use a light load and a spotter.
snake run:

Start with 5 cones and progress.
sparring:

Work with a partner you trust.
spinal curl:

Move slowly.
split squat jump with flying knee:

Drive the knee like a flying knee strike.
split stance alternating jump (cmj):

Be explosive.
split stance band chop - high to low:

split stance band rotation:

split stance banded first step hip proje:

split stance bent over cable rotation:

split stance bent over cable rotation -:

split stance box jump:

Drive off the front leg.
split stance counter movement jump (cmj):

Stay upright.
split stance counter-movement jump:

Stay upright.
split stance deadball load & rip:

split stance non counter movement jump (:

sprint:

stability ball tuck:

Keep your hips level.
staggered alternating plyo push up - con:

staggered plyo push up - continuous:

staggered plyo push up - single:

Keep your body straight.
staggered stance counter-movement jump:

staggered stance trapbar squat jump:

3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Go the other way

Stiff ankles.
travelling zig zag pogo hop - backward:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop backward diagonally left and right
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stiff ankle.
travelling zig zag pogo hop - forward:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop forward diagonally left and right
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep the zig zag tight.
travelling zig zag split stance pogo jum:
Steps
1. Stand in a split stance
2. Pogo forward diagonally left and right
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Keep going

Tip
Stiff ankles.
triple broad jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Broad jump forward three times in a row
3. Stick the last landing
4. Reset

Tip
Quick off the floor on the first two.
triple cross over hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a line
2. Hop forward three times, crossing the line each hop
3. Stick the last landing
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stay balanced.
triple hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop forward three times in a row
3. Stick the last landing
4. Switch legs

Tip
Quick off the floor.
trx i-y-t:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and lean back with straight arms
2. Pull your arms up into an I overhead
3. Return, then pull into a Y, then a T
4. Keep your body in a straight line

Tip
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
trx i-y-t - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold one TRX handle and lean back with a straight arm
2. Pull your arm overhead into an I
3. Return, then into a Y, then a T
4. Switch arms

Tip
Keep your body still.
trx t:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and lean back with straight arms
2. Pull your arms out to the sides into a T
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and collarbones wide.
underhand ez bar front raise:
Steps
1. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip
2. Raise it forward to shoulder height with straight arms
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Don't lean back.
upper calf stretch:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall in a split stance with your hands on it
2. Keep your back leg straight and heel down
3. Lean in until you feel a stretch high in the back calf
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Back knee stays straight.
waiters carry - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell overhead with a straight arm
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk for the set distance or time
4. Switch arms

Tip
Keep your bicep by your ear.
wall ball throw:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall holding a med ball at your chest
2. Squat down
3. Drive up and throw the ball to a target on the wall
4. Catch it and go into the next squat

Tip
Keep a steady rhythm.
wall drills (3 point load and lift with:
Steps
1. Lean into a wall at about 45 degrees with your hands on it
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Load the down leg, then lift it into two quick switches
4. Hold the finishing position

Tip
Keep your body in a straight line.
wall sit:
Steps
1. Lean your back against a wall
2. Slide down until your knees are at about 90 degrees
3. Hold for the set time
4. Stand up slowly

Tip
Push your back into the wall.
weighted shoulder tap:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with a plate on your upper back
2. Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder
3. Put it down and repeat on the other side
4. Keep your hips level

Tip
Widen your feet to make it easier.
zercher jefferson curl:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell in the crook of your elbows
2. Tuck your chin and roll down one segment of your spine at a time
3. Go as far as you can comfortably
4. Roll back up one segment at a time

Tip
Stay braced.
zottman curl:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms forward
2. Curl them up
3. Rotate your palms down at the top
4. Lower slowly, then rotate back

Tip
Keep your elbows by your sides.
